services.desc: Dolphin Tours are conducted on our luxury pontoon boats with your own captain and guide who will drive you to the mouth of the Homosassa River in search of dolphins. The dolphin often swim up river in search of food so we may see them at any point on our way to the Gulf. Our guides will share their knowledge of Homosassa’s history and ecosystem with you pointing out interesting landmarks from our historic town. Ecological tours by boat offer you the opportunity to see animals, fauna and flora unaccessible from the mainland. services.name: Eco Tours
services.desc: Dolphin Tours allow you to immerse yourself in the natural beauty of our waterways! Enjoy a relaxing cruise through pristine waters while keeping an eye out for dolphins and other incredible wildlife. Our friendly guides share fascinating stories and insights about the area’s marine life and ecosystem, making every trip both fun and unforgettable. Most of the time we’ll encounter dolphin while they are feeding. They may be found in the river or the Gulf corralling the baitfish into shallower water. services.name: Pontoon rental
services.desc: Rent a boat to get away from the world and enjoy a day on the water with family or friends. Chart your own course and get there at your own speed. Homosassa Boat rental because waterfront restaurants are more fun when you get there…. by water. Homosassa has 6 waterfront restaurants and bars where you can either eat on the boat or at their tables. Pack a lunch and picnic on the river or in the Gulf. Or spend a few leisurely hours just cruising and taking in the sights. A day on the boat is better than a day anywhere else. As they say, BOAT = Break Out Another Thousand. When boat ownership doesn’t make financial sense but you’re a boater, renting a boat from us gives you access to the water.
